question: is multi-tool near-mastered or failing outright?
finding: Multi-tool is not failing: 53/73 = 72.6% of multi prompts are answered correctly on all 8 samples, against 16/27 = 59.3% for single. But multi is also more often wrong outright (13.7% vs 11.1% zero-correct). The pair-producing middle band is therefore much thinner for multi (13.7%) than single (29.6%), which is why y_multi (0.137) is less than half y_single (0.296). Multi's lower yield is a bimodality effect, not a competence deficit.
consequence: The frozen weights make multi 73% of every sample, so the calibration run will be dominated by the stratum with the thinner middle band. Expect calibration y_std near the pilot's 0.180 rather than near y_single.
